result.summary: The page is largely well-designed with consistent styling, clear hierarchy, and good use of color. One minor visual defect stands out: the 'Popular right now' section header and its 'See all' link are not baseline-aligned, with the link sitting noticeably higher than the heading text. The partially visible carousel item on the right and the card cut off at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and are not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the 'See all' link is positioned higher than the section heading, so their text baselines do not align. By contrast, the 'Fastest near you' row aligns its heading and 'See all' link correctly, making the inconsistency visible.
issues.suggestion: Vertically center or baseline-align the 'See all' link with the 'Popular right now' heading, matching the alignment used in the 'Fastest near you' section for consistency.
